# Safe Evaluation Checklist: Task Pipeline Engine and Declarative Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-004 safe evaluator and validator requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and objectively implementable.
**Created**: 2026-05-01
**Feature**: specs/004-task-pipeline-engine/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are output-schema validation requirements complete for every numeric bound: output bytes, schema bytes, schema depth, object keys, array length, string length, pattern length, validation budget, and validator cache size? [Completeness, Spec §Output Schema Validation Safety Profile]
- [ ] CHK002 Are forbidden JSON Schema features completely enumerated, including remote and dynamic references, custom executable extensions, custom formats/keywords, async schemas, `ajv-formats`, format enforcement, mutation/default insertion, coercion, exhaustive error collection, and `$data`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are AJV configuration requirements complete enough to force strict validating behavior with no mutation, default insertion, type coercion, all-errors/exhaustive collection, format validation, `$data`, custom formats, custom keywords, remote loading, or async schema support? [Completeness, Spec §Output Schema Validation Safety Profile]
- [x] CHK004 Are accepted schema `pattern` and `patternProperties` requirements complete beyond `safe-regex`, including conservative subset approval and adversarial validation-time fixture coverage for accepted patterns? [Completeness, Spec §Pattern safety]
- [ ] CHK005 Are routing-expression grammar requirements complete for equality, inequality, membership, negated membership, conjunction, disjunction, negation, JSONPath operands, and literal right sides? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are routing pre-validation caps complete for rule count, expression bytes, token count, boolean nesting depth, JSONPath bytes, JSONPath result count, and literal bytes before parse or traversal work begins? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the requirement to reject JSONPath filters and script expressions before `JSONPath()` traversal unambiguous and tied to JavaScript execution being disabled during traversal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary between allowed left-side JSONPath operands and forbidden function calls, prototype-chain access, arithmetic, bitwise operators, right-side regex, and unsupported operators objectively specified? [Clarity, Spec §Routing Rule Evaluation Safety Profile]
- [ ] CHK009 Are validation and routing budget outcomes clear about parent task state, activity reason code, and successor suppression? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK010 Are malformed, oversized, timeout-budget, malicious, and valid fixture classes clearly required to avoid exception leaks and produce deterministic accept, reject, stall, or success outcomes? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are validator dependency requirements consistent between the direct runtime pins in the spec, the plan dependencies, and the supply-chain quality gate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK012 Are routing dependency requirements consistent between the direct runtime `jsonpath-plus` pin, the hand-written parser strategy, and the rule that JSONPath is only used for bounded traversal? [Consistency, Spec §Routing Rule Evaluation Safety Profile]

- [ ] CHK014 Are `safe-regex` requirements consistent in saying rejection is necessary but not sufficient, with accepted patterns also constrained by the SPEC-004 subset? [Consistency, Spec §Pattern Safety]
